# vpsie_protected_servers (Data Source)

Lists the servers the account protects, whatever created the protection.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vpsie_protected_servers" "paused" {
  state = "paused"
}

output "paused_servers" {
  value = [for s in data.vpsie_protected_servers.paused.servers : s.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `state` (String) Only servers in this state, as the platform names it (for example `protected` or `paused`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `servers` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the protection started.
- `identifier` (String) The protected server identifier.
- `name` (String) The server name.
- `paused_by` (String) Who paused the protection, empty when it is not paused.
- `policy_identifier` (String) The policy that protects the server.
- `source_identifier` (String) The Migrate source the server is read from.
- `state` (String) The protection state.
- `tier` (String) `backup` or `dr`.
